observations:
All conceptual domains in Torah #102 are covered by the four packages proposed in torah_102_packages.json. No independent bechina domain of 3+ concepts was found that is structurally separate from the existing packages.

Torah #102 is a brief, concentrated teaching with a single linear argument:
  Stage 1: Creation is for the revelation of God's malkhut [Package 2]
  Stage 2: The klipot are subdued under the Shechina through this [Package 4 — evil mirror of Package 2]
  Stage 3: Shefa is drawn down through prayer-words [Package 3]
  Stage 4: But only prayer grounded in earned yira is effective [Package 1]
  Stage 5: The tzaddik who rules through earned yira enables this entire chain [Package 1]
  Scriptural seal: The verse about Yosef and Pharaoh encodes the full structure [Packages 1+2+3 in the three equations]

The teaching is intentionally compact — ten lines of source text — with exactly four thematic domains identifiable through explicit bechina language. There is no fifth independent domain that could form a new package.

The good/evil mirror is present but asymmetric:
  - Package 2 (מַלְכוּת וְכִסֵּא, good) is mirrored by Package 4 (קְּלִפּוֹת, evil)
  - Package 1 (יִרְאָה, good) has no explicit evil counterpart developed in this Torah — the spontaneous 'higher yira' is mentioned briefly as the contrast to earned yira, but the source text does not develop it into a named domain with bechina connections
  - Package 3 (תְּפִלָּה וְתֵבוֹת, good) has no explicit evil counterpart in this Torah

This asymmetry is consistent with Torah #102 being a positive, instructional teaching ('here is how to reveal malkhut') rather than a diagnostic teaching ('here is what blocks it'). The evil dimension is acknowledged in one sentence (klipot subdued) and then the positive teaching proceeds.

No new package is warranted. All gaps discovered in the gap analysis (five new bechina edges and twelve new nodes) slot cleanly into the four proposed packages.
